text: Add an upper bound where the design is the prototype bell (for example a centre at most an eighth of the rate). Add a `mutant:` record of this change, with an input whose bell is in that range.
Add a check that a flushed take of n inputs makes at least n * l / m outputs (the harness's `want`). Add a `mutant:` record of this change with the input `32000-48000`, which is a flushed take.
We can write these changes for you. Reply here if you want that.
